The '''T5 force pike''' was a model of [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] The [[Rellarin]] [[Lunkar An]] used the T5 force pike as his weapon of choice.
